description: Run a CuNi program through CuNi Bank: submit source in Python or .cuni and get the exact output in the target language, or a refusal when the languages disagree. Read-only computation — no state is stored. Calls the CuNi Studio service (cuni-studio.fly.dev). Use for exactness checks and cross-language proofs; use spl_compress for byte compression, not program translation.

from.description: Source language: py for a Python v1-subset program, cuni for .cuni source. Defaults to py.

source.description: Source program to run: a Python v1-subset program or .cuni source text.

to.description: Target language for the output, e.g. js, go, ts, py. Required.

name: cuni_bank
